strings.menu.difficulty_easy_description: Zombies hit softer and go down faster, hordes are smaller, and hunger and thirst come slowly.
strings.menu.difficulty_hard_description: Zombies and animals hit harder, zombies take more killing, hordes are bigger, and you starve sooner.
strings.menu.help_2: Watch food, water, stamina and your core temperature. Eat, drink, and dress for the weather.
strings.menu.help_3: Every seventh night a horde comes for you. Build walls, and a door you can close.
strings.menu.help_4: Follow the journal at the top right: it walks you from your first tool to your first horde night.
strings.menu.help_6: WASD move, mouse look, Space jump, Left Shift sprint.
strings.menu.help_7: Left mouse: mine, chop, fight, or shoot a bow.
strings.menu.help_8: Right mouse: place blocks, plant seeds, eat and drink, wear clothes, fill bottles, till soil.
strings.menu.help_9: E: open crates, doors and beds. I: inventory. Tab: crafting. R: repair. Q: drop. Esc: pause.
strings.menu.help_11: Blocks carry weight. The crosshair shows how loaded a block is; one nearing 100% is about to fail and bring down what it holds.
strings.menu.help_12: Zombies dig through the weakest part of a wall, and will undermine what you stand on.
strings.menu.help_14: Berry bushes, crops and hunting feed you. Deer run from a sprinting survivor: walk, and use a bow.
strings.menu.help_15: Cook meat and boil water at a campfire. Raw meat and murky water make you sick.
strings.menu.tagline: Build. Scavenge. Survive the seventh night.
strings.menu.seed_hint: Leave empty for a random world
strings.menu.restored: Restored the world as it was when that session began.
strings.menu.controls_reserved: The mouse buttons and wheel, Escape, P and the number keys 1-9 cannot be rebound. Choosing a key another action uses swaps the two.
strings.menu.error_name: Give the world a name using letters or digits.
strings.menu.error_exists: A world with that name already exists
strings.menu.error_missing: That world could not be found
strings.traders.quartermaster_greeting: Rosa: "Coins for goods, goods for coins. Nothing with teeth gets past my fence."
strings.quests.trader.description: Someone is trading near here. Follow the compass to the outpost and make a deal.
strings.quests.first_tool.description: Two rocks and two planks make a stone axe. Open crafting with Tab.
strings.quests.timber.description: Chop down a tree with the axe and turn the logs into planks.
strings.quests.break_ground.description: A pickaxe gets rock out of stone.
strings.quests.four_walls.description: Build a shelter with a door before the first night falls.
strings.quests.place_to_wake.description: Sleep in a bedroll (E) and you will wake there when you die.
strings.quests.clean_water.description: Fill an empty bottle at water and boil it at a campfire.
strings.quests.hunter.description: Deer and foxes run from you. Walk, do not sprint, and use a bow.
strings.quests.hunter.game: Hunt a fox, deer or stag
strings.quests.farmer.description: Till soil with a hoe, plant seeds, and harvest them a day later.
strings.quests.dressed_for_winter.description: Hides make warm clothes. Right-click clothing to put it on.
strings.quests.standing_shelter.description: People keep asking the trader about the outlying places. Clear one out - a cabin, a shack, a way station, whatever is nearest - and report back.
strings.quests.standing_ruin.description: The trader wants the ruins kept quiet enough to send scavengers into. Five of them, out of a warehouse or the wreck, then come and say so.
strings.quests.standing_military.description: Anything with walls and soldiers in it is worth money to the trader. Three, from a bunker or the outpost.
strings.quests.job_cabin.description: The trader has heard something moving in a hunting cabin out there. Go and settle it.
strings.quests.job_camp.description: A logging camp went quiet. Two of them are still walking around in it.
strings.quests.job_bunker.description: There is a bunker on the trader's map with three of them inside. Clear it and the trader will pay for what you bring back.
strings.quests.job_ruin.description: A warehouse or the wreck on the beach - either will do. Five of them, and the trader is not fussy about which ruin they came from.
strings.quests.job_outpost.description: Nine soldiers, walls and a blockhouse. Do not go in the front gate at night.
strings.quests.seventh_night.description: Every seventh night the horde comes. Be ready, and live to see day 8.
